title: npm dependency version updates
summary: package.json and package-lock.json changes from a dependency version bump -- typically Dependabot-proposed, reviewed for breaking changes against this repo's actual usage before merge.

Scoped narrowly to dependency manifests only; a PR that also changes application code, tests, or CI configuration belongs to a different manifest, not this one. The one exception is pr-prepublish.yml itself, included only because introducing this manifest necessarily requires wiring it into that workflow's selector in the same commit -- not a general allowance to change workflows here.
risk: Varies by dependency: a patch bump within an already-accepted semver range is low risk; a major version bump gets its own explicit breaking-change review before this manifest is used to publish it.
No product UI, contact-form, or orchestration-domain source file is in this manifest's scope -- only the two dependency manifest files themselves.
testEvidence: npm ci installs cleanly from the updated lockfile.
npm run ci:quality and npm run ci:security pass for the candidate, same as any other PR.
npm run publication:scope -- --manifest agent-platform/publication/dependency-updates.json is run against the real candidate diff before publication.
documentationImpact: None expected for a routine version bump; a dependency swap or removal would need its own review outside this manifest's routine scope.
rollback: Revert the PR through the protected pull-request workflow, restoring the prior package.json/package-lock.json state.
This manifest is independent of phase-1.5-closure-hardening.json and process-and-docs.json -- editing or reverting it never affects either.
